data.one_liner: Generate PDF documents from HTML code templates in Flutter
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that converts HTML content, HTML files, or HTML file paths into generated PDF documents on Android and iOS. Supports common HTML markers, styling, web images, and local images.
use_when: You need to generate PDF documents from HTML strings or files
You want to render HTML templates with CSS styling and images into a PDF format
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS (like web or desktop), as they are not documented
You require a pure Dart PDF generation library without relying on native plugin capabilities
strengths: Allows generating PDFs directly from HTML content or HTML files
Supports loading both web-hosted images and local device images
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms based on documentation
Large documents with many images can affect final file size
data.setup_notes: Supports Android V2 embedding and iOS. Native configurations for webviews or local file access are handled by the plugin, but follow standard plugin installation.
